name: Hermansky-Pudlak Syndrome due to AP-3 Deficiency

criteria.description: Presence of oculocutaneous albinism with hypopigmentation of skin, hair, and eyes
Bleeding diathesis due to platelet storage pool deficiency
Recurrent infections due to neutropenia or immunodeficiency
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in AP3B1 gene
Absence or reduction of dense granules in platelets on electron microscopy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of oculocutaneous albinism, bleeding diathesis, and biallelic pathogenic variants in AP3B1 gene
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is confirmatory; platelet electron microscopy supports diagnosis.

pathognomonic.notes: Includes pale skin, light hair, and iris transillumination
searchTerms: very light skin and hair color
lack of pigment in skin and eyes
pale skin and hair from pigment loss

pathognomonic.symptomName: Platelet dense granule deficiency causing bleeding diathesis
pathognomonic.notes: Leads to easy bruising, mucosal bleeding, and prolonged bleeding times
searchTerms: easy bleeding due to platelet defect

pathognomonic.symptomName: Neutropenia resulting in recurrent bacterial infections
pathognomonic.notes: Predisposes to frequent respiratory and skin infections
searchTerms: low white blood cells causing infections
frequent bacterial infections from low neutrophils
repeated infections due to weak immune cells

common.symptomName: Nystagmus due to visual pathway abnormalities
common.notes: Involuntary eye movements often present from infancy
searchTerms: shaking eyes due to vision pathway issues

common.notes: Light sensitivity due to reduced pigmentation

common.symptomName: Prolonged bleeding after minor trauma or surgery
searchTerms: long bleeding after minor injuries or surgery

common.symptomName: Pulmonary fibrosis developing in adolescence or early adulthood
common.notes: Progressive lung scarring leading to respiratory compromise
searchTerms: lung scarring starting in teens or young adults

occasional.notes: Chronic inflammation of the colon causing diarrhea and abdominal pain
Enlargement of liver and spleen due to immune dysregulation

occasional.symptomName: Developmental delay or mild intellectual disability
occasional.notes: Reported in some cases, possibly secondary to hypoxia or infections
searchTerms: delayed development or mild learning difficulties

occasional.notes: Middle ear infections due to immunodeficiency

rare.symptomName: Pulmonary hypertension secondary to lung fibrosis
rare.notes: Elevated pulmonary arterial pressure complicating respiratory disease
searchTerms: high blood pressure in lungs from scarring
lung artery hypertension due to fibrosis
pulmonary high pressure caused by lung damage
frequent nose bleeding due to clotting issues

rare.notes: Rare cases with profound neutropenia and infections
searchTerms: severe immune deficiency with rare infections

laboratory: Platelet aggregation studies showing storage pool deficiency
Prolonged bleeding time with normal coagulation factors
imaging: High-resolution CT scan showing interstitial lung fibrosis
genetic: Biallelic pathogenic variants in AP3B1 gene confirmed by molecular testing
other: Electron microscopy of platelets demonstrating absent dense granules
Visual evoked potentials showing optic pathway abnormalities

distinguishingFeatures: Pulmonary fibrosis common but no immunodeficiency or neutropenia
Mutations in HPS1 gene instead of AP3B1
More severe immunodeficiency and neurologic deterioration

redFlags: Recurrent severe infections in early childhood
